name: Tokenization workbench
description: The tokenization workbench (formerly fraise-web's Tokenization view) as a project panel: type text and compare its segmentation and embedding-hierarchy composition side by side (by default the pilot-bpe8k, pilot-macro64k and pilot-fraise runs), computed by fraise's own fraise.workbench.tokenization in the project environment.

contributes.title: List fraise tokenizers, runs and hierarchy files
